observations: Photo 0 is very dark/underexposed, shot at night or in low light with no flash.
Shows the rear/side of a bulky CRT-style television (deep tube body, vented back panel) on a terrazzo floor.
No brand logo, model label, or screen-size marking is legible anywhere in the frame.
Front screen is not visible, so screen condition (cracks, burn-in) cannot be assessed.
No power cable, transformer, or visible damage/burn marks are shown despite the seller's claim.

claims.evidence: No LG logo or size label visible anywhere in photo 0; too dark to read any markings.

claims.claim: The transformer got blown up (implying it no longer powers on)
claims.evidence: No photo of the transformer, power board, or a failed power-on attempt is shown; taken at seller's word only.

risks.risk: Actual screen size may not be 29 inches as claimed.
risks.proof: A clear, lit photo of the front of the TV with a tape measure across the screen, or a legible size/model sticker on the back.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic/unspecified-size CRT TV, not confirmed 29-inch

risks.risk: Brand may not be LG; no logo visible.
risks.proof: Clear, well-lit photo of the LG logo on the front bezel or the rating label on the back.

risks.risk: Damage may extend beyond the transformer (tube failure, board damage, screen crack) since the unit cannot be tested remotely.
risks.proof: A video of the seller attempting to power the unit on, or a clear photo of the open back showing the blown component.
risks.if_unproven: priced as fully non-working, for parts/scrap only

risks.risk: Overall physical condition (cracks, cabinet damage, missing parts) is hidden by darkness.
risks.proof: Multiple well-lit photos from front, back, and both sides in daylight or with flash.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming cosmetic condition is poor

proof_requests: Well-lit photo of the front screen showing size and condition.
Clear photo of any brand/model/rating label on the back.
Photo or short video of the blown transformer/power board.
Video attempt to power on the TV, if possible, to confirm total non-function.
response.reason: Item is identifiable by type as a CRT television that the seller admits is non-working due to a blown transformer; lacking proof of brand, size, or extent of damage, it must be priced at worst case as an unverified-brand, non-functional CRT TV suitable only for parts/scrap.
